# skyhub_wireless (Resource)

WiFi settings of one band (id = band). Security is always WPA2-PSK/AES. Saving drops WiFi clients on that band for a few seconds. Isolation, WPS and the 2.4/5 GHz sync flag are left as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key is write-only: it is sent on create and whenever psk_wo_version
# changes, and never stored in state. Using the Vault secret's version makes
# a key rotation in Vault reach the hub on the next apply.
data "vault_kv_secret_v2" "skyhub" {
  mount = "secret"
  name  = "home/skyhub"
}

resource "skyhub_wireless" "band24" {
  band           = "2.4"
  enabled        = true
  ssid           = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.skyhub.data["wifi_ssid"]
  channel        = 0 # auto
  bandwidth      = "20"
  psk_wo         = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.skyhub.data["wifi_psk"]
  psk_wo_version = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.skyhub.version
}

resource "skyhub_wireless" "band5" {
  band           = "5"
  enabled        = true
  ssid           = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.skyhub.data["wifi_ssid"]
  channel        = 36
  bandwidth      = "80"
  psk_wo         = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.skyhub.data["wifi_psk"]
  psk_wo_version = data.vault_kv_secret_v2.skyhub.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `band` (String) `2.4` or `5`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Radio on.
- `ssid` (String) Network name (1-32 characters).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `bandwidth` (String) 2.4 GHz: `20` or `20/40`. 5 GHz: `80` (channel 36 only) or `40`.
- `channel` (Number) 2.4 GHz: 0 (auto) to 13. 5 GHz: 36 or 44.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Do not broadcast the SSID.
- `psk_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) WPA2 key (8-63 characters). Write-only: never stored in state. Sent on create and whenever `psk_wo_version` changes.
- `psk_wo_version` (Number) Change this value to send `psk_wo` again (e.g. the Vault secret's version).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `band`.
- `psk_set` (Boolean) The hub has a WPA key configured.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_wireless.band24 2.4
terraform import skyhub_wireless.band5 5
```
